validInclusionBlocks.interpretation: Slot retention does not retain a lifetime block list. Exact block coverage is in terminal evidence; no interior/steady TPS is inferred.

nodeCompletion.interpretation: Original endpoint node transaction-height Finalize and durable Commit returns joined by block hash; durable readback and published Info each match their own post-state height/hash. Calibrated wall-clock envelopes include client/node drift. These are completion observations after reported verified BFT proof, not the earliest quorum formation instant. Original native admission and cryptographic verifier remain mandatory.

processCPU.scope: RUSAGE_SELF process user/system CPU includes client HTTP, observer, decoder, Go runtime and GC; excludes separate nodes/other processes. Two cumulative samples bracket the client measurement; neither CPU nor wall durations are additive phase attribution.
